adjudication.rationale: The finding is accurate. Looking at the diff, in addGuests.handler.ts the `evt: CalendarEvent` object is constructed without a `team` property (lines 124-147). The booking query (lines 27-44) includes `eventType` but does not include team members. In email-manager.ts, the `sendAddGuestsEmails` function checks `if (calendarEvent.team?.members)` to send notifications to team members (lines 528-532). Since `evt.team` is never set in the handler, this condition will always be false, meaning team members/co-hosts in collective bookings won't receive notifications when guests are added. This is a real functional bug.
